rachel: Heads-up: Townhall scheduled Tue 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Please drop one-line Qs here by Mon 2026-05-11 18:00 PT. Short agenda below.

rachel: Agenda (45m):
- 10:00  Exec highlights: runway, growth metrics, hiring posture
- 10:10  Product & launch callouts (Redwood Optimize pilot + model audits)
- 10:20  Policy note: acceptable-use + partial telemetry changes
- 10:28  Incident recap: last week's Dedicated outage (5m summary)
- 10:35  Live Q&A (we'll take top 5 from this thread)
- 10:45  Close & next steps

devops-bot: Calendar created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/townhall-2026-05-12

miguel: Q: Quick request  can product clarify which customers are in the Optimize pilot? 1-line pls.

lia: Q: Will the acceptable-use policy change affect research API keys? (1-liner)

product-bot: Slides draft: https://docs.company.internal/allhands/may12-draft (edit perms: execs+product+people-ops)

hr-bot: Note: If you want to ask live, react :hand: below. We'll slot up to 6 people.

miguel: :hand:

ceo-anna: Please add questions about the Dedicated outage details here so eng can triage speaking points.

sam: Q: Any change to Dedicated SLAs after the outage? short answer please.

rachel: Good callouts. We'll prioritize: Dedicated SLA status, Optimize pilot customer list, AUP impact on research keys, and compliance timeline.

lia: Also request: short owner + ETA for telemetry reduction rollout.

product-bot: Note: Optimize pilot customer list is internal only; we'll surface anonymized criteria during townhall.

--- (POST-TOWNHALL) ---

hr-bot: Recording: https://recordings.company.internal/1803001234-townhall-may12 (available now)

product-bot: Final slides: https://docs.company.internal/allhands/may12-final

ceo-anna: TL;DR exec: ARR growth +10% QoQ, runway extended ~8 months on current plan, hiring focused on infra & reliability.

rachel: Product takeaway: Redwood Optimize pilot onboarding 5 customers; public guidance next quarter. Model audits will be regular for new model rollouts.

eng-lead: Incident recap: root cause was autoscaler race on Dedicated control plane; mitigations: lockstep controller patch and expanded probing. Compensating SLA credit offered to affected customers.

lia: Policy takeaway: acceptable-use tightened for high-risk PII workflows; research API keys unaffected for now. Telemetry reduction ETA: phased rollout starting 2026-06-01. Owner: lia (privacy).

sam: SLA takeaway: Dedicated SLA remains, but new guardrails for autoscaler limits + improved incident alerts. Detailed postmortem to be posted in #incidents.

rachel: Action items + owners listed in slides doc. We'll publish a one-page summary to handbook and send a follow-up email to all.

miguel: Thanks, useful session. Will follow up with product for pilot notes. :thumbsup:
